claim_text: Legius syndrome, caused by heterozygous SPRED1 pathogenic variants, presents with multiple cafe-au-lait macules with or without freckling, and no individuals with Legius syndrome have been reported to develop Lisch nodules or neurofibromas.
notes: Full text (PMC8354850). Data cited from a primary study (secondary citation in a consensus paper): refs 13, 14.
